# Isaiah Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 144r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:2** And-it-will-be [vehayah] in-the-last [be-acharit] of-the-days [ha-yamim], the-mountain [har] of-the-house [beit] of-YHWH will-be-established [nakhon] at-the-top [be-rosh] of-the-mountains, and-lifted [venissa] above-the-hills [mi-geva'ot]; and-all the-nations [kol-ha-goyim] will-flow [venaharu] to-it.

**2:3** And-many [rabbim] peoples [ammim] will-go [vehalekhu] and-say, "Come [lekhu] and-let-us-go-up [vena'aleh] to the-mountain of-YHWH, to the-house of-the-God of-Yaakov; and-he-will-teach-us [veyorenu] from-his-ways [mi-derakhav], and-we-will-walk [venelkhah] in-his-paths [be-orchotav]." For from-Tsiyon will-go-out [tetse] torah [instruction], and-the-word of-YHWH from-Yerushalayim.

**2:4** And-he-will-judge [veshafat] between the-nations, and-he-will-arbitrate [vehokhiach] for-many peoples; and-they-will-beat [vekhittetu] their-swords [charvotam] into-plowshares [le-ittim], and-their-spears [channitotehem] into-pruning-hooks [le-mazmerot]; nation [goy] will-not lift [lo yissa] sword against nation, and-they-will-not learn [lo yilmedu] war [milchamah] anymore [od].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.4 — "Swords into plowshares":** The most famous peace oracle in the Bible (paralleled in Micah 4:3). Joel 3:10 deliberately reverses it. The vision is of total disarmament driven by divine arbitration — nations no longer *learn* war.

**v.2-4 parallel in Micah 4:1-3:** Nearly identical text in both prophets. The relationship is debated: shared source, Isaiah borrowing from Micah, or vice versa.

*— EMET*
